usedFor: Each person who books in Calendly has their email checked by ClearBounce.

bestTemplate.name: “New Meeting Book or Invitee Created” in Calendly, then “Verify Email Address” in ClearBounce
bestTemplate.why: It checks each invitee's address as they book, catching typos before your follow-up list.

watchOut: “Create Bulk Job” takes a list of addresses, so “Verify Email Address” fits a single invitee better.
